g.text: Modular monolith design: Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, domain services, AI provider protocol, and PostgreSQL
TipTap Editor • React Flow Content Map
REST API v1 • OIDC / JWT • RBAC
Prioritizes Brief, Brand, Blocks • 8k Token Budget
Google Gemini Flash • Mock Local Test Double
Step-by-step user journey from authentication and website ingestion to governed AI content optimization
How every HTTP mutation travels through authentication, authorization, validation, service execution, and audit trail
Every SQL query explicitly filters by organization_id
Composite foreign keys guarantee zero cross-tenant leak
1. AuditLog: Records user, action, resource_type, timestamp
3. Atomic Commit: Data, version, and events commit together
Never exposes raw ORM models or database stack traces
4. AI Agent, Orchestrator & Tool Governance Flow
Governed multi-step agent execution with autonomous read steps and mandatory human approval gates for write steps
Autonomous read steps gather facts without mutating state:
Fetches document blocks and current word count
Evaluates headings, paragraph structure, word goal
Queries approved target URLs from linking graph
Matches anchor phrases in document blocks
Triggered when any WRITE tool is reached in the plan:
Confirms modified block exists and contains new link/text
New Version Saved in History • User Notified
5. SEO Strategy AI V1: Generation, Review, and Versioning
AI creates the initial draft; user reviews and explicitly saves Version 1; subsequent saves increment to Version 2+
PostgreSQL 17 schema: Tenant isolation via composite (organization_id, project_id) foreign keys and immutable version tables
7. Practical Backend Walkthrough: "Optimize this article and add relevant internal links"
End-to-end trace of how the backend executes an autonomous optimization request under human approval control
Architectural Guarantees Demonstrated in this Flow
1. Zero Autonomous Writes: The AI is physically incapable of directly mutating document blocks or publishing without human approval.
2. Immutable Document History: The original document is never overwritten in-place; approval triggers a version increment (V1 → V2) with full rollback capability.
3. Post-Patch Consistency Verification: VerificationService confirms that the version advanced and the link attribute exists in PostgreSQL before closing the workflow.
4. Tenant Boundary Enforced: Project permissions are verified on every call, preventing cross-organization document access or tampering.
